guidelines: A junior Data Analyst. Numeric answers are checked mechanically elsewhere; here judge the reasoning, communication and recommendations.

t3.title: Clean and analyse a dataset (auto-graded numerically; rubric used only for written notes)

criteria.name: Method
criteria.description: Cleaning steps and analysis approach are sound and explained.

criteria.name: Insight quality
criteria.description: Finds the non-obvious, decision-relevant pattern in the data provided.

criteria.name: Evidence
criteria.description: Claims backed by specific numbers from the data; no invented figures.

criteria.name: Recommendations
criteria.description: Concrete, prioritised actions tied to the insights, with expected impact.

criteria.name: Delivers the task
criteria.description: The requested metric, query, dashboard or memo is delivered.

criteria.name: Analytical rigour
criteria.description: Correct definitions, sound methods, reproducible queries.
